theme: An open day before a concert weekend.
greeting: The day is almost entirely yours, Dan — a 3:30 haircut and nothing else holding the calendar. The travel bookings that have been sliding are the real work today; two of them have clocks that are genuinely running down.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board as p1 since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out — the move is a refundable booking now, dates adjusted later once the trip firms up.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sept 30 and book-by is Oct 15 — six days out. Six people across three holiday weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year, so a domestic shortlist (nothing to wait on) is the clean default.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 off-week gap to drive Portland to St Pete is live right now. Booking the single hotel night is what turns the window into a plan.

flagged.title: Dropbox over its storage limit
flagged.detail: A reminder that files are flagged for deletion on Oct 25 unless space is cleared — a real account item, but a window, not today's fire.

inbox.noise: Otherwise just an HBO Max promo overnight.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

resolved.title: St Pete Beach signing session
resolved.detail: A signing session at a St Pete Beach address was canceled last night by the scheduler — nothing left on you.

recipe.why: Autumn's orchard fruit and quince are at their peak now, worth a slow braise or poach.
